author: iFixit
description:
If you’ve got an iPhone 15 Pro, you are probably noticing the battery is not lasting as long as it once did. The good news is you can replace the battery in your iPhone 15 Pro yourself! It’s a relatively easy process and it won’t take too long to do. There are a couple spots in here where it’s very easy to slice a cable or mess up a sensor, but we’ll walk you through everything step by step in this video.
